dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Hmm... Seeing as no one else is here, may I share something private with you?

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Sometimes I wonder if the Frostmoon Scions are a little too taken with antler and moon imagery...

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: The furnishings are beautiful, certainly, but you have to take care to avoid getting your hair or clothing caught in them.
